title.en: rapid – wolfsberg at the allianz stadion.

line.en: rapid at home to wolfsberger ac, friday 19:30. the listings disagree on whether tickets are sold out, so check the club site. a bar with a screen is the easy option.
line.de: rapid empfängt am freitag um 19:30 den wolfsberger ac. die angaben zu tickets widersprechen sich, daher auf der vereinsseite prüfen. eine bar mit leinwand ist die einfache wahl.
line.tr: rapid cuma günü 19:30'da evinde wolfsberger ac'yi ağırlıyor. biletlerin tükenip tükenmediği konusunda kaynaklar çelişiyor, kulübün sitesine bak. ekranlı bir bar kolay seçenek.

sparks.why: Rapid vs Wolfsberger AC, home bundesliga match fri 06.11 at 19:30 local, per FootballTicketNet (https://www.footballticketnet.com/austrian-football-bundesliga/rapid-vienna-vs-wolfsberger-ac-allianz-stadion-football-tickets/event/130014) and Starting11 (https://starting11.com/fixtures/rapid-vienna-vs-wolfsberger-ac).
